# Kumokage GmbH

> Zürich-based consultancy that designs, secures and runs cloud platforms for companies whose systems have to stay up, with a focus on AWS. Every engagement is led by a principal architect: the founder, Raffaele Sollecito. Site in English (/en), German (/de) and Italian (/it).

## Company
- Legal name: Kumokage GmbH (Kumokage Sàrl, Kumokage Sagl, Kumokage LLC), limited liability company under Swiss law, founded 2026.
- Registered office: c/o Enterprise Treuhand Partners GmbH, Schifflände 26, 8001 Zürich, Switzerland.
- UID: CHE-257.027.078. Commercial register of the Canton of Zürich: CH-020.4.093.816-5.
- Managing director: Raffaele Sollecito.
- Contact: info@kumokage.com, raffaele.sollecito@kumokage.com.
- Working languages: English and Italian. Serving Switzerland and Europe.

## What Kumokage does
- Landing zones and governance on AWS (Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs, IAM Identity Center with Microsoft Entra ID or Google Workspace), as code.
- Information security and compliance: network and edge perimeters, Security Hub remediation, immutable S3 Object Lock archives, incident response.
- Platforms and resilience: EKS and ECS platforms with GitOps, multi-region disaster recovery validated in live failover drills.
- AI systems: governed agentic platforms on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, delivered without static credentials.
- Fractional principal-architect mandates, project leadership and hands-on workshops.
- Cloud platforms: AWS today; Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud are planned, not yet offered.
